name: walk_fwd30_long20_v1
description: Whole-body WALK on the floor with the scripted no-slip tripod gait (gait 1), measured by the overhead camera (chassis tag position and heading on the floor grid): mean speed, straight-line travel against the command, heading drift, tilt, total current. The loop stands the robot up itself, streams the gait command, stops, and sits it down. Forward 30 mm/s for 20 s then back: twice the distance of the ladder, to see whether speed and drift hold up over a longer leg (the camera view is about 1.2 m; the run stops early if the robot nears the edge).
